title: QGI Stage 6 Shape Prototype Lock File
description: Per-recipe canonical shape prototype lock per Stage 6 pre-reg (qgi-docs commit e4f9e7a) §4.3. Production shape-feature emits MUST consult this artifact at run-start, SHA-verify the file content, and pin the prototype SHA in every result JSON. Prototype rotation requires F-H-4 amendment + Lakatosian guard F-Shape-1 (§6.2) + 8-seat ratification.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Loader raises on any other value (forward-compat guard).

filed.description: YYYY-MM-DD date this artifact was filed.

purpose.description: Free-text statement of artifact purpose; reproduced verbatim per §4.3 spec.

stage_6.description: Commit SHA of Stage 6 pre-reg merge in qgi-docs.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical-serialized JSON content of THIS file with metadata.file_sha256 cleared to the empty string. Loader recomputes and verifies on load; mismatch raises PrototypeIntegrityError.

n_recipes_with_prototype.description: Count of recipes with a fitted prototype entry.

n_recipes_substrate_inadequate.description: Count of recipes whose G1-G4 substrate gates failed; these are routed to ingredient+length fallback.

per_indicator_trajectory_signature.description: Per-indicator trajectory signature. Required to be non-empty when cascade_outcome='fit_locked'. May be empty {} when cascade_outcome='advisory_only_shape_unfittable' (F-H-4-A5: no prototype emitted; orchestrator routes to non-shape head per §4.2). Backward-compatible (pre-A5 entries always had ≥1 signature).

fit_method_commit_sha.description: qgi-ml commit SHA at which the fit method was run.

divergences_observed.description: F-H-4-A4 (qgi-docs 2026-05-20, 8-seat ratified 8/8). Sampler-diagnostic provenance written at gate-evaluation time per Marcus #8 rider. Reports observed divergences regardless of pass/fail so Lloyd's audit can re-evaluate under a different gate. Optional for backward compatibility with pre-A4 emissions.

cascade_outcome.description: F-H-4-A5 (qgi-docs 2026-05-20, 8-seat ratified) + stage-6-phase-1-closure-DECISION-2026-05-21 (8-seat ratified). Cascade disposition for the shape feature on this recipe. 'fit_locked' = shape prototype valid and locked (default). 'advisory_only_shape_unfittable' = §3.1.5 cascade exit clause invoked. 'phase_1_hard_falsified' = Stage 7 §6.1 HARD-FALSIFY routing: prototype is mathematically sound but the FEATURE derived from it failed F-S-1/F-S-3 + F-H-7 with margin; the production cascade reverts to ingredient+length-only. Future revival requires fresh pre-reg + fresh fit per F-Shape-1.

advisory_only_reason.description: F-H-4-A5: when cascade_outcome='advisory_only_shape_unfittable', the specific reason category. Currently the only enumerated reason is 'gp_fallback_nuts_gate_failure_after_operational_exhaustion'.

falsification_mode.description: Marcus #8 R-M8-1 rider on stage-6-phase-1-closure-DECISION-2026-05-21. Required when cascade_outcome='phase_1_hard_falsified'. 'baseline_regression' = WITH-shape LOCO regresses below an existing Hybrid LOCK baseline (e.g., civil_war_and_insurgency vs Hybrid D2/D5 at 0.7686). 'below_chance_no_baseline' = WITH-shape LOCO operates below random (0.5) without a Hybrid LOCK baseline to compare against (e.g., economic_recession rescue-mode failure).

falsification_ref.description: Marcus R-M8-1 rider: path to the binding DECISION artifact that ratified the falsification. Required when cascade_outcome='phase_1_hard_falsified'.

nuts_gate_failure_diagnostics.description: F-H-4-A5 (Marcus rider): exact sampler diagnostics observed on the failing fit attempt, preserved for Lloyd's audit and for substrate-class characterization in Phase 2 pre-screening. Required when cascade_outcome='advisory_only_shape_unfittable'.

operational_tooling_exhausted.description: F-H-4-A5 (Marcus rider): true when the recipe routes to ADVISORY-ONLY after operational-tooling exhaustion per §3.1.5 exit clause. Auditable flag; the nuts_gate_failure_diagnostics block must accompany this with the exact sampler config used for the final attempt.

substrate_class_note.description: F-H-4-A5: human-readable note characterizing the substrate class that drove ADVISORY-ONLY routing (e.g., 'slowly-varying structural/demographic indicators against T_r=5 window'). Tracks first-principles reasoning per Rasmussen & Williams 2006 §5.4.4.

existing_lock_unaffected.description: F-H-4-A5: companion cascade LOCK status (STRONG/MODERATE/MARGINAL Hybrid D2/D5) for ADVISORY-ONLY shape recipes; preserved here so consumers know the non-shape head is still routable.

fpca_component_scores.description: LKJ posterior mean of μ_r in FPCA score space (the Bayesian prototype location). Per QA B4 (2026-05-17): NOT the near-zero training-score sample mean.

posterior_cov_diag.description: Per-time-step diagonal of the trajectory-space Mahalanobis denominator. Per QA B5 + Priya adjudication (2026-05-17): back-projected LKJ posterior-mean Σ_r through V_r then Phi.

cov_diag_source.description: Provenance tag for posterior_cov_diag (Lloyd's audit surface). Expected value: 'posterior_mean_lkj_back_projected' (FPCA primary) or 'posterior_gp_f_r_empirical_cov_diag' (GP fallback). Optional for backwards compatibility with pre-B5 emissions.

gp_fallback_variant.description: F-H-4-A1 + F-H-4-A3 amendment provenance (qgi-docs 2026-05-18 / 2026-05-19, each 8-seat ratified). Present only on GP-fallback indicator signatures. 'v2_no_instance_gp' = post-F-H-4-A1 §3.1.4 model without g_c^(k), with InvGamma(2,1) on ell_recipe. 'v3_no_instance_gp_lognormal_ell' = post-F-H-4-A3 model with ell_recipe ~ LogNormal(log(1.5), 0.5) to address SE-kernel saturation multimodality at T_r=5 (Rasmussen & Williams 2006 §5.4.5; Stein 1999 §2.7). New emissions after the F-H-4-A3 merge MUST use 'v3_no_instance_gp_lognormal_ell'.

gp_fallback_amendment.description: F-H-4 amendment ID under which this GP-fallback prototype was fit. Expected value: 'F-H-4-A1' for post-2026-05-18 GP-fallback emissions. Optional for backwards compatibility with pre-amendment emissions (which never reached fit completion due to PyTensor kernel-argument crash).
